description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/delivery/executor.ex, attachments.ex, error.ex; Zaq.Materialization
Pass plan separately to executor. Reuse old group acquisition, preparation, upload phase then publication, root election, stop/continue, timeouts, bounded concurrency and release logic, subject to review. Direct-send prepares all groups first. Fixed groups/no automatic retry. Runtime owns bytes/results, never Outgoing or plan. Keep selected connection and requirements stable per attempt.

Tests to add before implementation: Group ordering for 15/5 files; failure stage/policy matrix; actual size drift; unknown optional ceilings; acquisition reuse; timeout/unconfirmed effects; uploads-only; no hidden retry; content lifetime; immutable inputs.

Branches/paths validated: Group ordering for 15/5 files; failure stage/policy matrix; actual size drift; unknown optional ceilings; acquisition reuse; timeout/unconfirmed effects; uploads-only; no hidden retry; content lifetime; immutable inputs.

Action reuse assessment: Reuse Zaq.Materialization and current signed Record authorization/provenance contracts. No duplicated download Action or raw source retrieval. Channel-private execution, injected runtime dependencies via existing opts. Nil identity never grants privileges.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.
